newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Financial proposes rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Asia Financial proposes rights issue.

text.p: Asia Financial Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it planned to raise net proceeds of about HK$524.7 million through a rights issue of not less than 254.96 million new shares.
It said four rights shares would be issued for every 11 existing shares at HK$2.10 per rights share.

Asia Financial said about HK$400 million of the proceeds would be used to increase the capital base of its Asia Commercial Bank Ltd unit and the balance to develop insurance and financial business opportunities in the Asia-Pacific region.
Asia Financial shares closed at HK$2.80 on Wednesday.
